The two lassos are almost the same drawing; B is only a touch lighter in the background, which is not enough to separate them.
B's chunky, smoothly shaded rope with soft shadows matches the smooth real scarf and fan, while A's fine, busy twist texture is the too-texture-y look the lessons rejected.
B's thick, rounded and smoothly lit rope reads like the real cards' soft, solid finish, while A's thin, finely twisted rope looks too textured.
